The error "GitHub Actions Script Injection — Use env Variables Instead of Inline Interpolation" occurs when you're using inline interpolation to inject environment variables into your GitHub Actions script. This is a security risk because it allows an attacker to inject malicious code.

Replace the inline interpolation with an environment variable. For example, if you're using a variable named `API_KEY`, you can define it as follows:

          echo $API_KEY
